title: 第一卷 第338章 鳞给我收回去硌到我了第一卷 第337章 咦又来个变态狗男人
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：笨蛋美人当团宠，师兄们抢疯了！
第一卷第338章鳞给我收回去，硌到我了（..la）百年前，卧龙宗大乱，好不容易共同渡过难关，小师姐却选择和宗门告别，据说是身体不好，要跟宗主去寻找治疗身体的东西。
宗主也在那时正式将位置传给大师兄，从此大师兄成为了宗主。
小师姐这一走，就是百年。
随着小师姐的离开，二师兄和小师兄也离开了。
整个卧龙宗都被抽走了主心骨一般元气大伤，尤其是慕潇婷，曾经跟着舒晩昭混，吃香喝辣的，舒晩昭一走，她也失去了宝贝的来源。
刚开始那几天，她每天都能梦见舒晩昭拿一堆宝贝塞她怀里，神神秘秘地和她说，“慕师妹呀，来，过来，姐求你个事儿，去帮我把宗主绑了，事成之后，宗主归我，宗门内的宝贝归你。”
然后梦里啥都有，她就真帮助舒晩昭把宗主绑了。
她没见过几次宗主，只记得对方是银色头发，梦里也是，不过梦里强大的银发宗主手无缚鸡之力地任由小师姐带走。
舒晩昭说话算话，事成之后果然把整个宗门的宝贝给了她，然后……轰隆一声，宝贝和那日的炼丹炉一样，炸了。
时隔这么多年，慕潇婷对小师姐的样貌和声音还是记忆犹新。
对方和仙尊一去就是百年，慕潇婷都快怀疑对方死在外面了，她更幻想过再次见面的场景，结果……竟然在龙族秘境，对方似乎还混得很好。
但是，舒晩昭竟然……
“舒晩昭，你竟然不记得我了？！”
那语气怨气冲天，仿佛被负心汉抛弃了百年寻上门来，却见负心汉翻脸不认人的苦命人。
蜷缩在舒晩昭脖颈上的紫色项链，一下子就把脑袋支棱起来了。
他的动作太明显，一下子就把舒晩昭对面的人吓坏了。
“这项链怎么会动？这是什么东西？好像是蛇？”
“不对，着蛇怎么有爪子？”
“爪子？天机阁的书卷记载类蛇只有龙才能有爪子，这不会是龙吧？”

“传说中的龙好像和神族有关，它这么一小只，和蛇似的，怎么可能是龙？”
有人已经拿出天机阁的资料以及小插画，开始对比。
几个小姐妹叽叽喳喳，唯有慕潇婷根本没有看龙一眼，她只是一味地用负心汉的眼神怒瞪舒晩昭，“舒晩昭，你有没有心？”
舒晩昭脖子上的苍恹，眼睛眯得更危险了。
舒晩昭觉得，自己的脖子有点紧，这条项链不太听话……
就在刚刚她和小龙……不对，和大龙急头白脸地吵了一架，大龙发了神经病，她一叉子就把他叉走。
见过龙和猫打架的广大群众都知道。
猫的速度是蛇的N倍，而蛇的七大姑蛟的八大叔也就是龙这种亲戚速度是猫的N倍，所以猫和龙打架，还是会吃亏的。
她一叉子过去，某龙随机应变，变成了一条小小迷你龙，就缠在她的叉子尖儿上，怎么甩都甩不掉。
因为他和蛇是远房亲戚，所以他会打蛇随棍上。
舒晩昭甩了半天没甩掉，他就这样一【表情】一【表情】地顺着那根棍子，爬上了舒晩昭的手腕，尾巴尖勾住她的肌肤勾勾缠缠，还很懒散地用龙爪摩挲着自己的下巴，“那条废物能当手链，我也可以，我这不是想攀比，就是想要证明一下我比它强。”
舒晩昭：“……但是手链没有爪子。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: A stupid beauty becomes the group's favorite, and the senior brothers go crazy over her!
Volume 1 Chapter 338: Take the scales back for me, they hit me (..la) A hundred years ago, the Wolong Sect was in chaos. We finally got through the difficulties together, but the young senior sister chose to say goodbye to the sect. It was said that she was in poor health and wanted to go with the sect leader to find something to heal the body.
The sect leader also officially passed the position to the eldest brother at that time, and from then on the eldest brother became the sect leader.
It will be a hundred years since the little senior sister left.
As the little senior sister left, the second senior brother and the little senior brother also left.
The entire Wolong Sect was devastated as its backbone was taken away, especially Mu Xiaoting, who once followed Shu Zhaozhao and was a popular and popular person. When Shu Zhaozhao left, she also lost the source of her treasure.
In the first few days, she could dream every day that Shu Mingzhao stuffed a bunch of treasures into her arms and said to her mysteriously, "Junior Sister Mu, come here, come here, I want to ask you a favor, help me tie up the sect master. After that, the sect master will belong to me, and the treasures in the sect will belong to you."
Then she had everything in her dream, and she really helped Shu Mingzhao tie up the sect leader.
She had not met the sect master a few times, but she only remembered that he had silver hair, and the same was true in the dream, but in the dream, the powerful silver-haired sect leader was helpless and allowed to be taken away by the young senior sister.
Shu Mingzhao kept his word, and when it came to fruition, he gave her the entire sect's treasure, and then... with a bang, the treasure exploded just like the alchemy furnace that day.
After so many years, Mu Xiaoting still has fresh memories of her little senior sister's appearance and voice.
It had been a hundred years since the other party and the Immortal Lord were gone. Mu Xiaoting almost suspected that the other party died outside. She even fantasized about the scene of meeting again, but...it turned out that... the other party seemed to be doing well in the secret realm of the Dragon Clan.
However, Shu Mingzhao actually...
"Shu Mingzhao, you don't remember me?!"
The tone of his voice was full of resentment, as if he had been abandoned by a heartless man and had been looking for him for hundreds of years, only to see the heartless man turn his back on him and refuse to recognize him.
The purple necklace curled around Shu Mingzhao's neck suddenly raised his head.
His movements were so obvious that they immediately frightened the person opposite Shu Mingzhao.
"Why does this necklace move? What is this? It seems like a snake?"
"No, why does the snake have claws?"
"Claws? The books of Tianji Pavilion record that only dragons can have claws among snakes. Isn't this a dragon?"
"The legendary dragon seems to be related to the gods. It is so small and looks like a snake. How can it be a dragon?"
Someone has already taken out Tianji Pavilion's information and small illustrations and started to compare.
Several little sisters were chattering, but Mu Xiaoting didn't look at Long at all. She just glared at Shu Zhaozhao with the eyes of a heartless person, "Shu Zhaoting, do you have a heart?"
The canghuan on Shu Xizhao's neck made his eyes narrow even more dangerously.
Shu Mingzhao felt that his neck was a bit tight and the necklace was not very obedient...
Just now, she had a heated argument with Xiaolong... no, she had a quarrel with Dalong. Dalong went crazy, and she took him away with a fork.
Everyone who has seen a dragon and a cat fight knows this.
The speed of a cat is N times that of a snake, and the snake's cousin, the eighth uncle, the dragon, is N times faster than the cat. Therefore, cats will still suffer in a fight with a dragon.
As soon as she passed the fork, the certain dragon adapted and turned into a small mini dragon, which got wrapped around the tip of her fork and could not be shaken off no matter how hard it was shaken.
Because he and snakes are distant relatives, he will hit snakes and then stick them.
Shu Mingzhao did not shake it off for a long time. He followed the stick one by one and climbed up to Shu Mingzhao's wrist. The tip of his tail hooked her skin and rubbed his chin lazily. "That piece of trash can be used as a bracelet, so can I. I don't want to compete, I just want to prove that I am better than it."
Shu Mingzhao: "...but the bracelet has no claws."
